title: 第17章 鼠鼠我啊真的要完蛋了第18章 绝版美酒
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
“谢谢大人。”卫兵晕乎乎的。
菲尔德伸手将他拉起来，用拳头在卫兵肩膀上捶了一拳，鼓励道“培养一个适合的兵员可不容易，我还等着你们脱离奴隶籍，成为真正的战士，甚至是骑士！”
卫兵听的热血沸腾，他之前一直把菲尔德的许诺当成画大饼，或是贵族的玩笑。但如今，他真切的感受到，菲尔德和其他的贵族，有点区别。
“为菲尔德大人冲锋！”
周遭的众人也被热血感染，疯狂挥舞长戟收割腐尸。
很快，被声音吸引来的腐尸被肃清一空，菲尔德粗略地数了一下，居然有七十多只腐尸。
菲尔德微吸了口凉气，但空气中的腥臭味立刻涌进气管，让菲尔德连忙闭上嘴巴，心里嘀咕“酒庄工作要这么多人吗？当初帝国决定引动死亡之雾的时候，为什么不通知北境的人撤离？”
“算了，关我屁事。”
不去思考无用的问题，菲尔德继续深入酒庄。
走了一阵子，菲尔德找到了酿酒的大房间，他幻想能找到冰糖、麦子之类的原料。
但回应他不切实际幻想的是，一具狰狞的蝙蝠女尸体，死不瞑目，从脖子到腹股沟，被暴力扯开，里面的内脏不翼而飞。
“这些大麦浪费了，原本是用来制作大麦酒的。”菲尔德注意到旁边还能被称为“大麦”的东西，散落一地，十年的时光，再加上腐化，已经让大麦粒能够缓慢蠕动，菲尔德惊叹腐化的神奇，“或许腐化并非魔鬼的诅咒，而是特殊的辐射。”
“辐射？”
阿诗娜大脑宕机，呆萌地琢磨起菲尔德说的新词汇，忽然她面色一变“当心，有东西在飞速靠近！”
速度快到菲尔德都没注意到，小地图上闪现而来的骷髅头标志。
“铛！”
站在前方的卫兵神情剧变，下意识看向天花板，刹那间，手中举着的盾牌陡然崩裂成许多块，卫兵手脚乱抓着倒飞出去。一只形似生化危机里的舔食者的怪物，出现在卫兵本来的位置，只有细长的尾巴和鼻子，让人知道，这是由老鼠变异而来。
鼠怪尖叫一声，挥动利爪朝着菲尔德抓去。
菲尔德只感觉一股劲风袭来，巨爪不断在眼前放大。
“休想！”

关键时刻，阿诗娜操控龙种狼闪身到菲尔德身前，蜷缩身躯将菲尔德牢牢遮挡。
噼里啪啦一阵爆响，伴随着大片的火花，龙种狼硬靠着鳞片抗下了爪击，连哼都没哼一声。看着眼前的巨狼，怪物也懵圈了，看了眼自己的利爪，无往不利的爪子，今天却只带下了两片带血的鳞片。
龙种狼抬手一巴掌，把鼠怪拍翻。
山猫等人立刻抓住时机，用腰刀和长戟猛劈乱砍，可鼠怪仗着皮糙肉厚，挨了那么多刀，只是受了些皮肉伤。它甩动修长的四肢，扫灰尘一般将七八人扫飞出去。要知道卫兵们可是穿全甲的，哪怕札甲不重，连人带甲也有百数十斤，居然如此轻易便打飞了。
content_en:
"Thank you, sir." The guard said in a daze.
Field stretched out his hand to pull him up, punched the guard on the shoulder with his fist, and encouraged, "It is not easy to train a suitable soldier. I am still waiting for you to break away from slavery and become a real warrior, or even a knight!"
The guard's blood boiled when he heard this. He had always regarded Field's promise as a pie in the sky or a joke among the nobles. But now, he really feels that there is a difference between Field and other nobles.
"Charge for Lord Field!"
The people around him were also infected by the hot blood and wildly waved their halberds to harvest the corpses.
Soon, all the rotting corpses attracted by the sound were cleared away. Field made a rough count and found that there were more than seventy rotting corpses.
Field took a slight breath of cold air, but the fishy smell in the air immediately poured into his trachea, causing Field to quickly close his mouth and mutter to himself, "Do the wineries require so many people to work? When the empire decided to trigger the fog of death, why didn't they notify the people in the north to evacuate?"
"Forget it, it's none of my business."
Without thinking about useless questions, Field continued to go deeper into the winery.
After walking for a while, Field found the large brewing room. He imagined that he could find raw materials such as rock sugar and wheat.
But what responded to his unrealistic fantasy was a ferocious corpse of Batgirl, dead with eyes open, violently torn open from the neck to the groin, and the internal organs inside were missing.
"This barley was wasted. It was originally used to make barley wine." Field noticed that what could be called "barley" next to it was scattered on the ground. Ten years of time, coupled with corruption, had allowed the barley grains to slowly wriggle. Field marveled at the magic of corruption. "Maybe corruption is not a curse of the devil, but a special radiation."
"Radiation?"
Asheina's brain was shut down, and she was thinking about the new words Field said in a cute way. Suddenly her expression changed, "Be careful, something is approaching quickly!"
The speed was so fast that Field didn't even notice the skull symbol flashing on the mini-map.
"Cang!"
The expression of the guard standing in front changed dramatically, and he subconsciously looked at the ceiling. In an instant, the shield he was holding suddenly broke into many pieces, and the guard flew backwards with his hands and feet. A monster that resembled the Licker in Resident Evil appeared in the guard's original position. It only had a slender tail and nose, making it known that it was a mutated mouse.
The rat monster screamed and swung its claws towards Field.
Field only felt a strong wind coming, and the giant claws continued to enlarge in front of his eyes.
"Don't even think about it!"
At the critical moment, Asuna controlled the dragon wolf to flash in front of Field, curling up to cover Field firmly.
There was a crackling sound, accompanied by large sparks, and the dragon-born wolf resisted the claw attack by relying on its scales without even grunting. Looking at the giant wolf in front of him, the monster was also confused. He glanced at his sharp claws, which were invincible, but today only brought down two bloody scales.
The dragon wolf raised his hand and slapped the rat monster over.
Shanmao and others immediately seized the opportunity and slashed with swords and halberds, but the rat monster only suffered some flesh wounds due to its rough skin and thick flesh. It swung its long limbs and swept away seven or eight people like dust. You must know that the guards are wearing full armor. Even if the armor is not heavy, even the armor weighs hundreds or dozens of kilograms, but they can be shot away so easily.
